title: CandlestickData
description: The price data (open, high, low, close) for the Candlestick representation.

o.description: The first (open) price in the time-range represented by the candlestick.
o.format: A decimal number encodes as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on the Instrument.

h.description: The highest price in the time-range represented by the candlestick.
h.format: A decimal number encodes as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on the Instrument.

l.description: The lowest price in the time-range represented by the candlestick.
l.format: A decimal number encodes as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on the Instrument.

c.description: The last (closing) price in the time-range represented by the candlestick.
c.format: A decimal number encodes as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on the Instrument.
